question: Which NFL star just got named in court as a fraud victim?
story: Travis Kelce was named in a federal courtroom this week as a victim of a twenty five million dollar Ponzi scheme. According to KY3 and First Alert 4, prosecutors named the Chiefs tight end on Tuesday, while a former investment adviser named Sid Jawahar was sentenced to eleven years in prison plus three years of supervised release. Here is what the case reportedly laid out. From twenty sixteen through twenty twenty three, Jawahar collected more than thirty five million dollars from investors in his fund, and only actually invested about ten million of it. The rest, prosecutors say, went to paying older investors with newer investors' money, and to private planes, luxury hotels and expensive restaurants. Kelce was reportedly an investor in that fund, something Forbes noted back in twenty twenty one. In court, almost nothing else was said about him. Prosecutors said they do not comment on individual victims. So it was just his name, read out loud, on a list.
